artworks.title: Louis Phelypeaux, comte de Saint Florentin
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Louis Tocqué
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The man is seated in a decorative chair, facing forward with his body slightly turned to the side. He is elegantly dressed in a richly embroidered robe over a buttoned waistcoat, knee-length trousers, and stockings. He has curled hair and a slight smile. He holds a sheet of paper in his right hand, and there is a feather quill and inkpot on the table beside him. The background features a decorated wall with columns and a draped curtain.

artworks.title: Marie Gallelise de la Fontaine
artworks.artist: Louis Petit after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait displaying the upper half of a person's body. The person is seated with their arms on a surface, positioned slightly to the side while facing forward. They have a calm expression with clear facial features like arched eyebrows, eyes, a nose, and a gentle smile. The individual's hair is neatly styled, appearing short. They are dressed in richly textured clothing with fur trimming along the edges and intricate lace detailing on the sleeve cuffs. An ornate coat of arms is visible below the portrait. The background is monochromatic, highlighting the subject.

artworks.title: Charles Francois Paul Le Normant de Tournehem
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait. He is standing with a slight turn to the left and his head facing the viewer. He has a composed expression with arched eyebrows and a small smile. The man's hair is styled in voluminous curls, likely a wig from the 18th century. He is wearing an embroidered coat with floral motifs, lace-trimmed cuffs, and a ruffled cravat. His right hand rests on a piece of furniture draped with fabric, with a sculpture of a female figure holding a staff on it. The background features a large decorative vase on a pedestal to the left and heavy drapery with tassels on the right. The image has a monochromatic tone typical of an engraving.

artworks.title: Don Philippe, Infant d'Espagne
artworks.artist: Jean-Joseph Balechou after Louis Rene de Vialy
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up in a seated posture, looking directly at the viewer. He has a fair complexion, delicate facial features, and long curly hair framing his face. He is dressed in elegant period-style attire with a silky texture and intricate detailing. Around him is a textured frame that resembles draped fabric. In the foreground, there is a decorative crest or shield with ornate patterns and a crowned emblem. The backdrop behind the man consists of intricately lined and shaded areas that enhance the depth and richness of the portrait.

artworks.title: Samuel Liber Baro de Cocceji
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt after Jean Pesne
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a stone archway frame, facing forward with elaborate white hair and ornate attire, including a jacket, sash, and star-shaped insignia. Below him is a cherubic figure holding an open book on a stone ledge with heraldic emblems and carved text. The background is shadowy, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Charles Duc Regnant de Brunswick
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy after Ludolf Ernst Andreas Lafontaine
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a middle-aged man standing outdoors with one hand on a walking stick or staff. He has a round face, full cheeks, a long nose, and light-colored eyes. His hair is styled in a formal manner typical of the 18th century, possibly a powdered wig or naturally styled hair. He is dressed in formal attire with a high-collared shirt, a double-breasted coat with decorative buttons, a sash with an emblem featuring a cross and crown, and a garment with tassels around the waist. The background features a densely wooded area with large trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Jacques Benigne Bossuet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a person from the waist up, set against an elaborate background. The individual is seated with a slight turn towards the viewer, showcasing a composed demeanor. They have angular features, a straight nose, and a calm expression. The hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and light, framing their face. The person is attired in ecclesiastical robes, including a buttoned garment with a white collar. A large cross pendant hangs around their neck. The textured background enriches the portrait, with shadows adding depth. At the bottom of the image, there is a Latin inscription next to a crest.

artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Robert van Audenaerd after Carlo Maratta
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure lying on a bed surrounded by multiple individuals. The central figure is reclined slightly with a calm expression, looking upwards. The surrounding people are engaged in various activities like conversing or reading from a book. They are all dressed in long robes and some have distinctive features like flowing hair and beards. In the background, there is a doorway and architectural details.

artworks.title: Louis Philippe d'Orléans
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image portrays a young boy from the waist up, facing slightly to his left. He has a round face, soft cheeks, curly hair with a parting and a bow, and a calm expression. He wears a detailed coat with decorative buttons, lace cuffs, fur trimming, and intricate patterns. The oval frame around him has an inscription, and below the portrait is an ornate base with a coat of arms with three fleur-de-lis, surrounded by floral motifs and a crown. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Three Bathers in the Sea
artworks.medium: black crayon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract figures or forms in a monochromatic composition using bold charcoal lines. The central area features three vertical forms that suggest figures standing or interacting. The surrounding area includes sweeping lines and shapes that imply a simplified landscape or setting. The drawing conveys movement through the fluid and spontaneous application of charcoal.

artworks.title: Young Girl Dressing
artworks.medium: graphite on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person tying or adjusting their hair. The individual is facing left and is shown from the upper torso up. They have delicate facial features and curly hair pulled back, with both hands lifted above their head. The person is wearing a garment with detailed patterns on the back and sleeves, including buttons and lace or embroidery. The background is plain, and there is cursive text across the sketch.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash and graphite on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman seated from the waist up. Her body is slightly turned to the side with her head facing forward. Her facial features are stylized with faint outlines, and her hair is styled in a neat, rounded bun. She is wearing a dress with voluminous sleeves and a flowing skirt, shown through the use of fluid lines and shading. She holds an indeterminate object in her hand. The background is minimal, with basic shading and line work forming an abstract, muted setting that adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Design for an Architectural Framework
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design with intricate details. The drawing depicts an elaborate architectural frame that includes mythical figures and decorative elements. The upper part features two reclining cherubic figures on either side, surrounded by swirling, acanthus-like ornamentation, topped with a central decorative urn or crest. The columns on either side are personified as caryatids. At the base, intricate scrollwork and panel details are depicted. The line work in the drawing is precise, with careful attention to the ornamental and structural details.

artworks.title: Imperfectorum Academia (Academy of the Imperfects)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash over black chalk, incised for transfer, on laid paper
artworks.description: This image features two allegorical figures surrounded by intricate ornamental designs and symbolic objects related to knowledge and learning. The figure on the left wears robes, a helmet, and holds a shield and baton, while cherub-like children are below them. The figure on the right holds compasses and is surrounded by instruments and books. In the center, there's a shield with the word "ATTENVANDO" and an emblem with a building-like structure. The drawing style includes detailed lines and a limited color palette of blues and earth tones. The text along the bottom reads "IMPERFECTORVM ACADEMIA."

artworks.title: Two Seated Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated face to face engaged in conversation. Both have bearded faces, curly hair, and halos above their heads. They wear flowing robes. The person on the left has clasped hands on their lap, while the person on the right gestures while speaking. There is no background detail.

artworks.title: Seated Woman
artworks.medium: red and white chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated figure with loose lines and light shading, capturing the entire body in a side view pose. The figure's facial features are minimal and abstract, with simple lines for the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the hair is indicated with light curves. The person is wearing a long gown with visible sleeves and a fitted bodice, along with an elegantly curved back chair. The background is plain with no distinct details or objects present.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Venus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological procession featuring a chariot, with a central chariot being drawn by elaborately adorned horses. The figure at the helm of the chariot is holding an object. Multiple figures surround the chariot, some appearing to be interacting or in motion. The horses are intricately decorated with harnesses and in motion. The drawing uses fine lines and detailing to convey movement and grandeur.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome drawing featuring three figures arranged in a triangular formation. On the left is an elderly man holding a long staff with both hands, extending his right hand forward. The central figure is a donkey, and on the right, a woman is seated on a rock with a cherubic child on her lap. Overhead, in the sky, is a celestial figure amidst radiant lines. The background consists of abstract, flowing lines resembling clouds or a glowing atmosphere.

artworks.title: An Angel
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a figure in profile, leaning slightly forward with an arm raised. The face is turned to the side, featuring delicate features. The figure has curly hair flowing around the head and is draped in a loose robe with detailed folds, all depicted in an earthy, monochromatic palette. Large wings are shown around the figure, adding to the sense of flow and motion. The background is simple, matching the tones of the figure and wings.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and white gouache heightening over red chalk
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting multiple figures in dynamic poses. The figures appear to be engaged in various interactions. The central figure stands out amidst the others. The sketch-like style and use of light and shadow create a sense of drama. The background is filled with indistinct forms, adding to the chaotic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Allegory in Honor of a Gentleman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with a warrior in armor fighting a lion with a spear. Angelic figures are depicted above and around the scene. The background includes grand architecture with columns and arches. A robed figure stands within one of the arches. Mythical figures are shown flying or floating in the clouds and sky. The composition features a monochrome palette and detailed lines to convey drama and motion.

artworks.title: Saint Nicolas of Bari
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over graphite on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a formal and authoritative pose. He has a long beard, a serious expression, and is wearing an ornate robe, an elaborate tall hat, and holding a staff and a book. The background includes pillars, curtains, and candlesticks.

artworks.title: The Ruins of the Colosseum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with figures present.

artworks.title: Church Tower on a Hill
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows a monochromatic drawing with an elevated perspective looking down upon a rocky landscape interspersed with sparse vegetation. A chapel-like structure with arched openings and bells is located towards the upper right on a ridge. The horizon is faintly indicated by the line of the ridge and the structure itself. The brushstrokes are fluid and somewhat loose, giving the rocks and trees a natural, flowing form. The overall color palette consists of varied shades of brown, ranging from light to dark. The visual impact is soft and harmonious, with subtle contrasts adding depth to the imagery.
